artifacts.name: Corpus to effective training distribution
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Repair a contaminated split and an overrepresented source while retaining a declared target-domain coverage floor.
artifacts.limits: Small authored/permissioned corpus; no claim of production-scale cleaning or automatic legal clearance.

artifacts.name: An inspectable language model that actually learns
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Find a deliberately wrong mask or missing gradient, repair it, reproduce a reference update and demonstrate bounded held-out learning.
artifacts.limits: Small enough for bounded portable computation; precomputed reference checkpoints may supplement, not replace, actual visible updates. No frontier capability claim.

artifacts.name: Continuation, adapters and retention
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Meet a new-domain objective while keeping a declared old-domain regression tolerance; show the tradeoff rather than just the best new score.
artifacts.limits: Continual-learning outcomes depend on the selected tasks; a successful toy replay experiment is not universal forgetting prevention.

artifacts.name: Demonstrations, preferences and checkable rewards
computedEvidence: reward and KL with separate denominators
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Choose an objective from the feedback available, reproduce a numerical update, then detect reward hacking on a different scoring rule.
artifacts.limits: Finite policy and tiny decoder tracks make algorithms inspectable; toy policy updates must not be marketed as an RLHF reproduction or safety certification.

artifacts.name: An experiment that can fail honestly
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Select a model using development data, justify a final-test conclusion with uncertainty, and decline an unsupported deployment/generalization claim.
artifacts.limits: Human/specialist review remains separate; no automated test-count threshold demonstrates learner mastery.

artifacts.name: Measured small-run scaling versus fitted assumptions
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Reject a fit outside its measured regime and choose a budget allocation supported by the available runs.
artifacts.limits: Browser time is not accelerator throughput; toy scaling is not a vendor or AGI forecast.

artifacts.name: A learned answer within a controlled evidence/tool loop
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Diagnose a cited but irrelevant answer and a tool failure; preserve unauthorized-action rejection while completing an allowed alternative.
artifacts.limits: Synthetic environment with no real external effects. Retain current TF–IDF baseline so added neural machinery earns its cost.

artifacts.name: Learn a cross-modal representation
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Show whether an answer depends on the image/audio rather than a text shortcut.
artifacts.limits: Tiny authored examples; audio data needs explicit consent/rights and a separately reviewed representation.

artifacts.name: From noise to samples through a learned field
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Explain the difference between training steps and sampling steps and demonstrate the error of an incompatible sampler/objective.
artifacts.limits: Two-dimensional numerical data makes equations inspectable; visual appeal is not evidence of physical world understanding.

artifacts.name: Predict, plan or learn a policy, then act
artifacts.learnerAcceptance: Expose model exploitation or compounding prediction error, shorten/replan or collect informative data, and evaluate the resulting policy in withheld states.
artifacts.limits: Simulation only; no claims of physical robot safety or specialist control-system review.
